purpose: Portable adaptations of private integration helpers; no captured runtime evidence or site configuration is included.
revision_note: Historical context only. These private helper files were not all tracked at those revisions. Hashes identify the actual adaptation inputs. Record the current NL-BIOMERO commit and installed component versions for each new acceptance run.
changes: Runtime arguments replace private credentials, paths, project names and workflow IDs.
Only explicit owned connections and supplied workflow/task/job identities can be faulted.
Running allocation checks, dormant hook installation, cleanup and expected-outcome checks are explicit.
Reports contain allowlisted evidence; raw exceptions, configuration and command output are excluded.
Compose execution examples are separate from portable Python integration logic.
Phase hooks retain the original native retry boundaries; partial filenames are reduced to basenames in reports, and shared private report writing is reused.
Terminal auditing reuses configured client lifecycle and reports only source event types/versions, statuses and supplied workflow identities.
validation_scope: Offline tests establish argument safety, private loopback relay cleanup, error-output redaction and real temporary SQLite event-store initialization/replay. They do not establish live SSH or workflow acceptance.
